x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate shell commands or answers with OpenRouter.

options.name: --bash
options.description: Generate a bash command. Shorthand for --shell bash. [default: False]

options.name: --shell
options.description: Target shell for command generation (powershell, bash, zsh). Overrides the configured default.

options.name: --models
options.description: List available OpenRouter model IDs. [default: False]

options.name: --model
options.description: Override the configured OpenRouter model ID.

options.name: --execute
options.description: Execute the generated command after displaying it and prompting for confirmation. [default: False]

options.name: --question
options.description: Ask a question and print the answer instead of generating a command. [default: False]

options.name: --file
options.description: Include up to 3 files in the AI request context.

options.name: --raw
options.description: Disable markdown formatting on question output. [default: False]

options.name: --timing
options.description: Print timing information for the AI call and overall request to stderr. [default: False]

options.name: --no-history
options.description: Do not record this invocation in history. [default: False]

options.name: --history
options.description: Search and display history. Remaining arguments are used as a search term. [default: False]

arguments.name: GOAL
arguments.description: The natural-language goal or question to send to the AI.
